title: Strong enough for the life you love
headline: Strong enough for the life you love
caption:
What does strong actually mean to you? 💪

For us, it isn't about the heaviest weight or the longest plank.

It's carrying the shopping without a second thought. Getting down on the floor and back up with ease. Standing tall at the end of a long day.

That's the strength we build at POWR, through reformer Pilates in the Ribble Valley, Mat, Stretch and 1-2-1s, at a pace that suits you.

The clocks go back this Sunday, so it's a good moment to give your darker evenings something that's just for you.

Find the class that fits your week through the link in our bio.

📍 POWR Studio, 9 York Street, Clitheroe
